trial_title: A Study of the Effectiveness, Safety, and Tolerability of Carisbamate as Add-On Therapy in Patients With Partial Onset Seizures.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness, safety, and tolerability of carisbamate as add-on therapy for the treatment of partial onset seizures in patients with epilepsy.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced ≥2 partial onset seizures in the last 6 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: had a neuroimaging procedure (computed tomography [CT] or magnetic resonance imaging [MRI] within the past 5 years that excluded a progressive neurologic disorder
eligibility_table.justification: The patient had an MRI that showed atrophic changes in the left temporal lobe, which likely occurred within the past 5 years, thus excluding a progressive neurologic disorder.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of inadequate response to at least 1 antiepileptic drug
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of seizures and has been on multiple antiepileptic drugs, indicating an inadequate response to at least one.

eligibility_table.criterion: Current treatment with at least 1 and up to 3 antiepileptic drugs. To be eligible for the double-blind treatment phase of study CARISEPY3013, patients must: have at least 6 partial onset seizures during the 56-day baseline period
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently on three antiepileptic drugs (valium, Dilantin, phenobarbital) but has not had the required 6 partial onset seizures during the 56-day baseline period, as the first seizure occurred at age 13 and there is no indication of recent seizure frequency.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have not had >= 100 partial onset seizures per 28 days in the baseline period
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had >= 100 partial onset seizures per 28 days, as they have only recently developed seizures.

eligibility_table.criterion: And no seizure-free period of more than 3 weeks during the baseline period.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been seizure-free for more than 3 weeks during the baseline period, as they just started having seizures at age 13.
